lines.zh: 我在雪地里慢慢走，不着急。
lines.en: I walk the snow slowly, unhurried.
My hooves crunch down through the snow.
The chain drags and rattles behind me.

lines.zh: 寒气让我的呼吸结了霜。
lines.en: The cold frosts my breath.
I skirt around the frozen lake.

lines.zh: 每到一个村子我都停一停。
lines.en: At every village I pause.
I walk steadily with the sack on my back.

lines.zh: 风把我的毛吹得竖起来。
lines.en: Wind lifts my fur upright.
I follow chimney smoke to find my way.
The snow is deep; I lift my knees.

lines.zh: 我数着这个冬天的名单。
lines.en: I count the names on this winter's list.
The tenth night has come and gone.
I wind the chain around my wrist.

lines.zh: 袋子里还有几样没送出去。
lines.en: A few things in the sack remain undelivered.
I hone my horns and hear a distant bell.
Cold is nothing more than air to me.
I sit, and the snow reaches my knees.
I can smell who has been naughty.

lines.zh: 我呼出的白气，凝在角上。
lines.en: My breath frosts over my horns.

lines.zh: 炉火的烟味让我想起旧账。
lines.en: Woodsmoke reminds me of old debts.
I count the reindeer passing by.

lines.zh: 这村子今年安静得反常。
lines.en: This village is strangely quiet this year.
I scrape the ice with one nail.

lines.zh: 名字我都记着，一个不落。
lines.en: I remember every name. Not one missed.
My chain drags through the snow.
This year's list is not finished yet.
You are on the list. Stop pretending.

lines.zh: 第十夜之后，我专找淘气的人。
lines.en: After the tenth night, I hunt the naughty.

lines.zh: 你今年做过什么，我都记着。
lines.en: I remember what you did this year.

lines.zh: 站直些，我要看清你的脸。
lines.en: Stand up straight; let me see your face.
Why are your hands shaking?
I am patient. I always find time.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂的东西，给我看看。
lines.en: Let me see what hangs at your belt.
The lamp in your house still burns.
Do not look behind you. No one is there.
Tenth night. Still no door locked?
Were you good this year? Tell me.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，因为你不高。
lines.en: I look down because you are short.
This pain is less than a winter night.
A tuft of my fur is singed off.
A good hit. Try again.
A small crack runs through my horn.
The tenth night isn't over yet.
The chain slipped; I wind it tight again.
My chains rattled loose — I'm marking this one.
Blood on the snow freezes fast.
The sack tore and things spilled out.
I breathe hard enough to melt the snow.

lines.zh: 一块甜的东西，也许可以。
lines.en: Something sweet might change my mind.

lines.zh: 把糖放在雪上，然后退开。
lines.en: Set the candy on the snow and step back.
I smell fresh-baked cake.
This is not a bribe; it is a toll.
A gift for the children. I accept.
Open the sack. Let me look.

lines.zh: 我不吃甜的，但可以带走。
lines.en: I do not eat sweets, but I will take them.
One more piece; I have not agreed.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起别的冬夜。
lines.en: This smell recalls other winter nights.

lines.zh: 拿东西换名字，可以商量。
lines.en: Goods for a name. We can talk.
You walked into my chain.
I am this large; the road this narrow.

lines.zh: 我的角差一点碰到你的头。
lines.en: My horn nearly met your head.
Make way. I am carrying things.

lines.zh: 你推不动我，别人试过了。
lines.en: You cannot move me. Others tried.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩进你的雪里。
lines.en: My hoof sank into your snow.
We collided and snow fell from the tree.

lines.zh: 别挡门口，我还有好几家。
lines.en: Don't block the door; I have houses left.
Your shoulder brushed my sack.
I walk this road every year.
The tenth night brings snow, not company.
Something like me is not meant for company.
Would you walk a while with me?
Keep away from my chain.

lines.zh: 我背的袋子里没有你的份。
lines.en: The sack holds nothing for you.
Winter nights are long and words are few.

lines.zh: 我记得有一个冬天不冷。
lines.en: I remember one winter that wasn't cold.
Why do you smile? I rarely do.
My hands are too cold. Do not hold them.
Go. I must be back before dawn.
This goes into my sack.
Things dropped in snow belong to me.
I hook the boot onto my strap.
I take the child's wooden horse.
A brass bell. It rings nicely.
I will borrow your door bolt for now.
The sack grows heavy. I like that.
I set the gift on the doorstep.
This loaf is still warm.
I pick it up and offer no explanation.
This house's chimney still smokes.
I see a shadow in the window.

lines.zh: 名单上这个名字，找到了。
lines.en: That name on the list. Found it.
Fresh footprints mark the snow.
Someone over there is laughing loudly.
The smell of mischief is thick here.

lines.zh: 我看见门后有一双眼睛。
lines.en: I see eyes behind the door.
The one with the axe. Stand still.

lines.zh: 寒风吹来你身上的气味。
lines.en: The cold wind brings your scent.
It hides behind a tree. Too thin.
The hearth is out, so they are asleep.

lines.zh: 就是它，我认得那件外套。
lines.en: That is it. I know that coat.
It cannot run; the snow is deep.
I approach slowly, without startling it.
There is still a lamp burning in that house.
Smoke from the chimney means someone is home.
This gift has to be delivered by hand.
A bell rang once. It was not you.
I set the sack down in the snow.
I loop the chain once and grip it.

lines.zh: 你手里那件家伙，我打掉过。
lines.en: That thing in your hand? I've knocked it down before.

lines.zh: 寒气把它的呼吸显出来。
lines.en: The cold makes its breath visible.
My horns line up with its shoulder.
It heard something and stopped.
Stay still. Moving makes it faster.

lines.zh: 它手里的东西会掉下来。
lines.en: The thing in its hand will drop.
The snow is bright; it cannot see me.

lines.zh: 从左边来，右边留着退路。
lines.en: From the left, leaving the right open.

lines.zh: 我听见它的心跳慢下来。
lines.en: I hear its heartbeat slowing down.
This blow goes for the wrist.
I have waited all year for this.

lines.zh: 你退到雪线边上，没路了。
lines.en: You've backed to the snow line. No way left.
I set the sack down in the snow.
You back to the wall. The wall is cold.
The whip cracks once against the ground.
Do not turn and run. I know the snow better.
I count your faults first, then I move.
The chain has gone round once. Long enough.

lines.zh: 这一下把它手里的剑打飞了。
lines.en: This blow sends its sword flying.

lines.zh: 我的链子抽在它的背上。
lines.en: My chain lashes across its back.
My horns butt it back three steps.
Your weapon is gone. What is left?
I seize its wrist and twist.
A line of red appears on the snow.
This punch settles this year's debt.
It grabs its weapon; I knock it down again.
My hoof lands on its chest.
Do not beg. I do not listen to that.
It doubles over in pain. Perfect.
I kick its shield into the snow.

lines.zh: 这一击我只用了半分力。
lines.en: I used only half my strength for that.

lines.zh: 倒下的人我一个都不忘。
lines.en: I forget none of the ones who fell.
The tenth night passed; only now I come.
I walk out of the blizzard.

lines.zh: 今年淘气的实在太多了。
lines.en: There has been far too much mischief this year.
The snow stopped. My hour has come.

lines.zh: 这个村子太小，也太安静。
lines.en: This village is too small and too quiet.

lines.zh: 链子的响声先到，我才到。
lines.en: The chain is heard before I arrive.
I come with an empty sack to fill.
Someone left sweets outside the door.
The cold enters the village with me.
I break through the first layer of ice.
The list is long; the night is short.
I come down from the northern ridge.
All the doors are shut. That is fine.

lines.zh: 我又来了，你们该记得我。
lines.en: I am back. You should remember me.
In the blizzard, I land first.
The bells start ringing from the trees.
This year I came early.
The lamp at the village gate burned all night.
My horns push up out of the snowdrift.
I hoist the sack onto my shoulder.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的毛，有股焦味。
lines.en: Fire singes my fur; it smells burnt.

lines.zh: 我从屋顶摔下来，砸进雪堆。
lines.en: I fell off the roof into a snowdrift.

lines.zh: 冰水灌进来，我的腿僵了。
lines.en: Icy water pours in; my legs stiffen.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的袋子撕开了。
lines.en: The blast tore my sack open.
An arrow is stuck in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这咒语烫得我头皮发麻。
lines.en: This spell burns my scalp numb.

lines.zh: 我空着肚子走了一整夜。
lines.en: I walked all night on an empty stomach.

lines.zh: 雷电劈在角上，眼前发白。
lines.en: Lightning hit my horns and my sight went white.
This place does not even have winter.
